content: Specification of the destinationType in a EcucForeign- ReferenceDef Since the AUTOSAR Generic Structure Template [6] requires the class names of all Identifiable s to be unique within the AUTOSAR 'M2:: AUTOSAR Templates' metamodel, it is sufficient to provide only the actual class name of the referenced class in the destinationType , as shown in example 2.20.
